instruction: Cache proxied responses for 10 minutes with a 100 MB zone.
Bypass the cache for requests with an Authorization header.
Serve stale content when the backend is down or busy.
Enable open_file_cache to reduce disk lookups for static files.
Add a cache-busting key that varies by host and request URI plus Accept-Encoding.
Set long browser cache expiry for images and JS/CSS assets.
Turn on sendfile and tcp_nopush for efficient static file delivery.
Compress text responses with gzip for the most common MIME types.
Use Brotli if available, falling back to gzip.
Raise client_max_body_size for large uploads on a specific endpoint.
Enable fastcgi caching for a PHP app for 1 hour.
Purge a cached object with a custom PURGE method.
Cache static assets at the edge but never cache HTML.
Add a debug header showing whether a response was a cache hit or miss.
Enable microcaching for 1 second to absorb traffic spikes.
Cache only GET and HEAD requests, never POST.
Add Expires and Cache-Control for a download directory, forcing revalidation.
Prefetch and cache upstream connections with a keepalive upstream.
Disable logging of cached static asset requests to reduce disk I/O.
Use a memory-only cache zone and slice large range requests.
